steps.name: DESeq2 model: design ~ batch + condition, Wald test
steps.question: Controlling for the two balanced processing batches, which of the filtered genes are differentially expressed between treated and control kidney samples (design ~ batch + condition, condition releveled with control as reference)?

grounding.reason: Balanced batch goes into the design as a fixed covariate before condition (R-0006/R-0012); explicit reference level and named contrast (R-0036); DESeq2 Wald as primary test at n=6/group (R-0001); with n=6<7 per cell, Cook's-distance outliers get NA p-values, reported per R-0039.

Design formula ~ batch + condition fit with DESeq() (median-of-ratios size factors, Wald test)
Results extracted for contrast condition treated vs control
Count outlier flags (Cook's distance, NA p-values) reported separately from independent-filtering NAs

steps.name: apeglm LFC shrinkage on DESeq2 result
steps.question: What is the shrunken, noise-reduced log2 fold change for treated vs control for each tested gene?

grounding.reason: Single coefficient (condition treated vs control) -> apeglm; unshrunken MLE kept alongside per R-0009.

acceptance_criteria: lfcShrink run with apeglm on the condition_treated_vs_control coefficient
Shrunken LFC reported alongside the unshrunken MLE estimate in the results table

steps.name: BH multiple testing with independent filtering
steps.question: Which genes pass a Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value < 0.05 after DESeq2 independent filtering?

grounding.reason: BH adjustment at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering on, selecting by padj only, per R-0010/R-0043.

acceptance_criteria: results() called with alpha=0.05 (matches reporting cutoff) and independent filtering left on
Final DE gene list filtered by padj < 0.05, not by raw p-value or fold change alone
Counts reported: genes tested after filter, genes with NA from independent filtering, genes with NA from Cook's outlier flag, genes significant at padj<0.05

steps.name: edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test cross-check
steps.question: Does an independent edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design (~batch+condition) and same filtered counts reproduce the DESeq2 treated-vs-control gene calls, and what is the overlap between the two methods?

grounding.reason: edgeR QL F-test as the second method for robustness at n=6/group; intersection reported as high-confidence set per R-0042.

acceptance_criteria: edgeR DGEList built from the same filtered raw counts, TMM normalization, design ~batch+condition
glmQLFit / glmQLFTest run for the condition coefficient
Genes significant at FDR<0.05 from edgeR compared against the DESeq2 padj<0.05 list
Overlap (intersection) reported as the high-confidence gene set; genes unique to each method reported as a secondary set labeled by method

Report states: enrichment database (Hallmark) and version, rank metric, universe, size window, and that enrichment findings are method-dependent hypotheses, not proven conclusions
Report explicitly notes DESeq2/edgeR count-outlier NA handling and any flagged samples from QC

plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE, batch-adjusted
plan.analytical_narrative: 12000 x 12 raw salmon gene counts (kidney, human), 6 treated vs 6 control, with two known processing batches balanced across conditions. Batch is included as a covariate in the DESeq2 design rather than removed via count adjustment, per standard practice for a balanced batch. Pipeline: QC of sample structure (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to confirm batch does not dominate and no outlier sample exists -> minimal low-count pre-filter -> DESeq2 with design ~ batch + condition, Wald test, apeglm LFC shrinkage, BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05 -> edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design as a robustness cross-check, with the DESeq2/edgeR overlap reported as the high-confidence gene set -> fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark using the DESeq2 Wald statistic as rank metric -> consolidated report with full methodological detail (design, thresholds, package versions, n tested/n DE, enrichment parameters).

steps.method: keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (6)
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic vs MSigDB Hallmark
